name: Hafif Anti-Lice Shampoo 50ml
description:
Hafif Anti-Lice Shampoo 50ml 
Apply Scully on the scalp and damp hair. 
Crushed all over, especially scalp and cones, I left 5 minutes. 
Rinse with water then repeat again. 
Should shampoo with Scully, repeat after first use 7-10 days or when lice are found 
Kill Lice & Eggs 
Easy & Fast 
Safe & Effective 
Made in Thailand
